title: Preferred-Languages must not appear more than once

spec.name: RFC 9116
spec.normative_quote: The order in which they appear is not an indication of priority; the listed languages are intended to have equal priority. This field MUST NOT appear more than once.
spec.note: Transcribed from a live fetch of https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9116.txt on 2026-08-31. The two sentences are adjacent in the source across a paragraph break, which normalizes to a single space; no words are altered and no passage is spliced. The preceding sentence is carried deliberately: 'This field MUST NOT appear more than once.' is also a substring of the §2.5.5 Expires sentence, so quoting it alone would not identify §2.5.8 uniquely in the source.

applicability: A security.txt body containing at least one Preferred-Languages: field with a non-empty value. The field itself is optional (§2.5), so a body without it is not a violation.
expectation: At most one line matches /^Preferred-Languages:[ \t]*\S/ (case-insensitive, per-line). Multiple language tags belong on ONE line, comma-separated -- repeating the field is the violation.

cases.name: one Preferred-Languages field listing three tags -- this rule does not fire
no Preferred-Languages field -- the field is optional, so this rule is inapplicable
